bootstrap.procedure: Paired game-row resampling with replacement, shared row indices across pairs within cohort, 2.5/97.5 percentile endpoints with linear (B-1)*q interpolation. Descriptive historical uncertainty; no multiple-comparison winner selection.

metrics.log_loss: Natural log; original epsilon=1e-15 clipping for log loss only
metrics.calibration: Existing 10 equal-width probability buckets with n, mean probability and observed frequency; retain empty buckets
metrics.classification: Home iff p>=0.5, ties home; preserve stored floating-point probabilities without rounding
metrics.market: Unchanged preferred valid two-sided YES quote with candle end <=cutoff, lag<=1200 seconds; actual quote age unknown; no trade substitution
metrics.missingness: Each named cohort uses exact common games with finalized verified outcome and every listed probability. Never replace missing prices, failed/insufficient forecasts or unattempted calls. Source-missing groups contribute LR1 only under frozen semantics. All 150 IDs, failure reasons and exclusions retained. Primary pair never conditioned on v1 or market availability.

execution.order: Existing evaluation hash run order; for each game direct, then all four v2 groups A-D, then v1 A-D. Order independent of labels, prices and responses. Primary methods receive priority within each game; denials can yield incomplete final game.
execution.stop: Global stop of new inference on first HTTP403 or other access denial (401/407/451, explicit top-level auth/permission error, denial HTML). Other failures are preserved without retries. Unknown claims never resend. Budget checked before every new request using cumulative conservative reservations and known recorded costs.
execution.cache: Original shared caches: captures/forecast_cache, captures/leap_nba_v1_cache, captures/leap_nba_v2_phase2_cache. Failed terminal requests reused, never retried; uncertain claims block new execution. Single immutable authorization binds output to plan.
execution.timing: All three methods sealed under one global completion manifest before any outcome/market join or held-out score inspection. Inference never imports evaluator or accesses labels/prices.

diagnostics.strength_directionality: Original strict criterion: weaker only if season win fraction AND average point differential are both strictly lower. Common assessable successful strength observations for v1-v2 comparison. Missing/tied/discordant/source/inference exclusions explicit; never correct forecasts.
diagnostics.groups: Success-only LR, signed log-LR and absolute log-LR distributions, home/away/neutral counts, qualitative categories and sufficiency; failed/insufficient/unattempted separate from legitimate source skips.
diagnostics.injury_dependence: Preserve report states and source verification flags; report one-sided submission, injury strata, common A/B reinforcement and offline leave-one-group-out on explicit intersections. Never fit group weights.
diagnostics.development: Compare already published development cohorts A n50 and B n40 against corresponding held-out cohorts with explicit IDs/n and cohort differences. These are different game sets, not paired generalization estimates; no combined development/held-out tuning.

resources: Record planned/cached/reserved/claimed/captured/success/invalid/insufficient/failure/unattempted counts by method and group, exact stopping reason, HTTP status, token usage and unknown-usage reserves. Rates retain frozen per-method values; cost estimates are not invoices. Latency sums are not wall-clock time. Shared alpha variants do not duplicate cost.
